## Checklist

- [ ] Rendered and looked at, cropped at full resolution
- [ ] `node engine/review.mjs` without warnings (the template, the experiments touched; every template if `engine/` changed)
- [ ] Deterministic: no `Math.random`, `Date` or state between frames
- [ ] Everything drawn by code; fonts and sounds freely licensed
- [ ] The lesson written into the skill it belongs to
- [ ] New style: kit, template, skill, style test, `styles/<style>/README.md` + `strip.jpg`, README and `sandbox/INDEX.md` rows
- [ ] No private material, keys or third-party footage; studied work credited
